note: The base doc specifies per-volume PRINT pricing only. This ladder maps that same value range onto a Patreon subscription structure. Tiers are gated via Patreon access rules (benefits/tiers). Single source of truth for the uploader.

tiers.name: The Feed (Free)
tiers.maps_to_base: Top-of-funnel sample; base doc does not price free content.
unlocks: Daily issue (1 real page) as an individual searchable post

tiers.name: Ponderable ($5/mo)
tiers.maps_to_base: Below base $7.99/vol — monthly slice of one volume's worth of chronicle.
unlocks: Weekly chronicle volume PDF (52-53/week per year) as gated posts

tiers.name: Archivist ($12/mo)
tiers.maps_to_base: Anchored to base $12.99 top of range — full multiverse access monthly.
unlocks: 30-pages/day MULTIVERSE AU spins (alternate-universe posts) gated per day

tiers.name: First Principles ($13/mo)
tiers.maps_to_base: Just above base $12.99 — complete collected works, annual bundles.
unlocks: Full annual multiverse PDF (11k+ pages) + yearly collection index post

individual.description: One Patreon post per daily issue. Searchable via tags. Free tier (public).

multiverse_individual.description: One Patreon post per day's 30 AU spins (or split into a few). Gated to Archivist.

collection.description: One yearly COLLECTION post indexing all that year's individual posts. Public hub for accessibility.

weekly_volume.description: One gated post per weekly volume PDF (links/attaches the local PDF). Gated to Ponderable.
